title: IELTS Writing Lab｜复核句型训练
based_on: 用户过往 IELTS Academic Task 1/Task 2 作文中的真实错误与批改记录

lessons.title: 句子完整性与句子连接
lessons.note: 任何完整句至少要有主语和限定谓语。Because/Although/While 从句不能单独承担完整论证；两个独立句不能只用逗号连接。
lessons.wrong: People supporting small-class learning mainly because it’s benefits. / There are several measures can be applied.
lessons.right: People support small-class learning because it offers personalised guidance. / Several measures can be introduced.
patterns: 主语 + 谓语 + 宾语/补足语
Because + 原因从句, + 主句
两完整句：句号 / 分号 / 连词
There are several measures that can be introduced.

exercises.prompt: People ___ small classes because they offer more individual attention.
exercises.answer: support

exercises.prompt: Several measures ___ be introduced to reduce food waste.
exercises.answer: can

exercises.prompt: ___ digital reading is convenient, printed books still serve a purpose.
exercises.answer: Although

exercises.prompt: Governments should address this issue ___ it affects local communities.
exercises.answer: because

exercises.prompt: People supporting small classes mainly because its benefits.
exercises.answer: People support small classes mainly because of their benefits.
exercises.explanation: 补上主句限定谓语；because of 后接名词。

exercises.prompt: I believe AI is useful, it may also create risks.
exercises.answer: I believe AI is useful, but it may also create risks.
exercises.explanation: 不能只用逗号连接两个独立句。

exercises.prompt: 小班教学有优势，但是它并不是语言学习成功的必要条件。
exercises.answer: Small classes offer benefits, but they are not essential to successful language learning.
exercises.explanation: 两个完整分句以 but 连接。

exercises.prompt: 虽然数字阅读很方便，纸质书仍然有自己的作用。
exercises.answer: Although digital reading is convenient, printed books still serve a purpose.
exercises.explanation: Although 引导完整让步从句。

exercises.prompt: 用两句话解释为什么博物馆应定期更新展览，包含“因为”和“结果”。
exercises.answer: Museums should update their exhibitions regularly because local residents may find familiar attractions less interesting. As a result, fresh displays can give them a reason to return.
exercises.explanation: 检查完整主谓与因果衔接。

lessons.title: 主谓一致与动词时态
lessons.note: 单数不可数名词作主语通常搭配单数谓语（tourism, information, online reading）；复数主语用复数谓语；根据 Task 1 的历史/预测时间选择时态。
lessons.wrong: Tourism generate income. / Online reading have the benefits. / AI drive learning more accessible.
lessons.right: Tourism generates income. / Online reading has benefits. / AI has made learning more accessible.
patterns: 单数主语 + does / has / is
复数主语 + do / have / are
过去年份的数据：rose / fell / remained
过去的预测数据：was predicted to / was expected to

exercises.prompt: Tourism ___ income for local communities.
exercises.answer: generates

exercises.prompt: Online reading ___ become increasingly popular.
exercises.answer: has

exercises.prompt: Large crowds ___ additional pressure on public facilities.
exercises.answer: place

exercises.prompt: In 1976, the employment rate for men ___ from 70% to approximately 92%.
exercises.answer: rose

exercises.prompt: Inadequate recycling infrastructure prevent waste from being recycled.
exercises.answer: Inadequate recycling infrastructure prevents waste from being recycled.
exercises.explanation: infrastructure 作为整体通常不可数，搭配单数谓语。

exercises.prompt: The number of tourists have risen since 2010.
exercises.answer: The number of tourists has risen since 2010.
exercises.explanation: the number of + 复数名词：主语核心是 number，谓语单数。

exercises.prompt: 规律运动有助于缓解压力并改善睡眠质量。
exercises.answer: Regular exercise helps relieve stress and improve sleep quality.
exercises.explanation: exercise 此处是不可数名词，谓语用 helps。

exercises.prompt: 在2011年，女性就业率先上升，随后下降。
exercises.answer: In 2011, the employment rate for women rose initially and then declined.
exercises.explanation: 使用过去时描述过去数据。

exercises.prompt: 写两句分别描述2010—2017年游客人数的变化和AI对当前学习的影响。
exercises.answer: Between 2010 and 2017, the total number of visitors increased substantially. Today, AI-powered tools provide learners with immediate feedback.
exercises.explanation: 注意 Task 1 过去时和社会现象一般现在时。

lessons.title: 情态动词、被动语态与过去分词
lessons.note: can/may/should + 动词原形；被动语态为 be + 过去分词。动词词形错误会直接影响语法准确性。
lessons.wrong: can keeps body healthier / students can learning / food is throw away / should be implement
lessons.right: can help maintain a healthy weight / students can learn / food is thrown away / should be implemented

exercises.prompt: Regular exercise can ___ people maintain a healthy weight.
exercises.answer: help

exercises.prompt: These measures should be ___ by local governments.
exercises.answer: implemented

exercises.prompt: Unsold perishable food may be ___ after major holidays.
exercises.answer: discarded

exercises.prompt: Household waste is often ___ of rather than recycled.
exercises.answer: disposed

exercises.prompt: People can benefits from a balanced diet.
exercises.answer: People can benefit from a balanced diet.
exercises.explanation: can 后接动词原形。

exercises.prompt: Much edible food is throw away every day.
exercises.answer: Much edible food is thrown away every day.
exercises.explanation: 被动语态：is + thrown。

exercises.prompt: 这些风险可以通过适当的监管得到缓解。
exercises.answer: These risks can be mitigated through appropriate regulation.
exercises.explanation: can be + 过去分词。

exercises.prompt: 政府应该采取有效措施来减少食物浪费。
exercises.answer: Governments should introduce effective measures to reduce food waste.
exercises.explanation: should + V 原形。

exercises.prompt: 写两句：第一句使用 should，第二句使用 can be + 过去分词，讨论回收。
exercises.answer: Governments should provide convenient recycling facilities. More household waste can then be recycled instead of being discarded.
exercises.explanation: 两种不同谓语结构。

lessons.title: 动词固定结构：to do 与 doing
lessons.note: 最容易出错的结构：encourage sb to do；prevent sb from doing；avoid doing；be used to doing；devote time to doing；take responsibility for doing。
lessons.wrong: encourage residents take part / be used to check / devote to learn / take responsibility to save food
lessons.right: encourage residents to take part / be used to checking / devote time to learning / take responsibility for reducing food waste

exercises.prompt: Museums should encourage local residents ___ visit more often.
exercises.answer: to

exercises.prompt: Students are used to ___ their phones every morning.
exercises.answer: checking

exercises.prompt: Many learners devote time to ___ their speaking skills.
exercises.answer: improving

exercises.prompt: Individuals should take responsibility for ___ food waste.
exercises.answer: reducing

exercises.prompt: Governments should prevent companies to waste edible food.
exercises.answer: Governments should prevent companies from wasting edible food.
exercises.explanation: prevent sb from doing。

exercises.prompt: People should avoid to buy more food than they need.
exercises.answer: People should avoid buying more food than they need.
exercises.explanation: avoid doing 而非 avoid to do。

exercises.prompt: 定期更新的展览可以鼓励居民再次参观。
exercises.answer: Regularly changing exhibitions can encourage residents to visit again.
exercises.explanation: encourage sb to do。

exercises.prompt: 许多学生已经习惯使用AI获取答案。
exercises.answer: Many students are used to using AI to obtain answers.
exercises.explanation: be used to + doing。

exercises.prompt: 使用 devote...to doing 和 take responsibility for doing 写两句说明学习者的责任。
exercises.answer: Students should devote time to practising a foreign language regularly. They also need to take responsibility for evaluating the accuracy of AI-generated information.
exercises.explanation: 介词 to、for 后接 V-ing。

lessons.title: 冠词、可数与不可数名词
lessons.note: 表达“一种/一个”常需要 a/an；information, news, advice, waste, equipment, infrastructure 等通常不可数；people, students, skills, articles 等可数复数。
lessons.wrong: maintain healthy weight / different culture / many news / a good command of foreign language
lessons.right: maintain a healthy weight / different cultures / much news / a good command of a foreign language
patterns: much information / a piece of news

exercises.prompt: A healthy diet can help people maintain ___ healthy weight.
exercises.answer: a

exercises.prompt: Students need a good command of ___ foreign language.
exercises.answer: a

exercises.prompt: International tourism can help visitors understand different ___.
exercises.answer: cultures

exercises.prompt: Many people read the latest ___ on their phones.
exercises.answer: news

exercises.prompt: The informations from newspapers are more reliable.
exercises.answer: The information from newspapers is more reliable.
exercises.explanation: information 不可数，且主谓一致。

exercises.prompt: They should build more recycling infrastructures.
exercises.answer: They should develop better recycling infrastructure.
exercises.explanation: infrastructure 通常不可数。

exercises.prompt: 高昂的学费可能阻碍来自低收入家庭的学生。
exercises.answer: High tuition fees may discourage students from low-income backgrounds.
exercises.explanation: fees 复数；backgrounds 复数。

exercises.prompt: 规律运动有助于降低患糖尿病的风险。
exercises.answer: Regular exercise can help reduce the risk of diabetes.
exercises.explanation: the risk of + 疾病名词。

exercises.prompt: 写两句分别包含 a healthy weight 和 information，注意冠词及主谓。
exercises.answer: A balanced diet can help people maintain a healthy weight. Reliable information is also important when making health decisions.
exercises.explanation: 区分单数名词与不可数名词。

lessons.title: 介词与固定搭配
lessons.note: 把词组作为整体记忆：at a reasonable price; benefit from; interested in; face difficulties / be faced with; familiar with; depend on; contribute to; access sth（动词）。
lessons.wrong: in a reasonable price / face with difficulties / appeal tourists / access to better communication / benefit in broader ways
lessons.right: at a reasonable price / face difficulties / attract tourists / have access to better communication / benefit from
patterns: face difficulties / be faced with difficulties
have access to sth / access sth

exercises.prompt: Consumers can buy fresh food ___ a reasonable price.
exercises.answer: at

exercises.prompt: Students benefit ___ individual feedback.
exercises.answer: from

exercises.prompt: The success of a business depends ___ market conditions.
exercises.answer: on

exercises.prompt: Tourists may be interested ___ local customs.
exercises.answer: in

exercises.prompt: Young people may face with financial difficulties.
exercises.answer: Young people may face financial difficulties.
exercises.explanation: face 是及物动词；或用 be faced with。

exercises.prompt: Digital services help rural students access to education.
exercises.answer: Digital services help rural students access education.
exercises.explanation: access 作动词直接接宾语。

exercises.prompt: 高门票可能使居民不愿经常参观博物馆。
exercises.answer: High admission fees may discourage residents from visiting museums regularly.
exercises.explanation: discourage sb from doing。

exercises.prompt: 游客对当地文化和传统更感兴趣。
exercises.answer: Tourists are often more interested in local culture and traditions.
exercises.explanation: interested in。

exercises.prompt: 写两句，分别用 benefit from 和 depend on 讨论语言学习。
exercises.answer: Learners can benefit from personalised feedback. However, long-term progress also depends on consistent practice.
exercises.explanation: 注意介词及句子逻辑。

lessons.title: 平行结构、比较级与数量词
lessons.note: 比较对象必须同类、结构尽量平行；rather than、not only...but also 后形式对称；much 用于不可数、many 用于可数，fewer/less 区分数量。
lessons.wrong: choose to buy a house rather than renting one / not only provide... also enhance / more affordable than physical books / reduce less pollution
lessons.right: choose to buy a house rather than rent one / not only provide... but also enhance / more affordable than printed copies / reduce pollution
patterns: choose to do A rather than do B
not only + V but also + V
fewer + 可数复数 / less + 不可数

exercises.prompt: Some people choose to buy a home rather than ___ one.
exercises.answer: rent

exercises.prompt: Community events can not only attract visitors but also ___ local identity.
exercises.answer: strengthen

exercises.prompt: E-books are often ___ affordable than printed copies.
exercises.answer: more

exercises.prompt: Better collection services could result in ___ household waste.
exercises.answer: less

exercises.prompt: Students can not only improve their vocabulary but also to develop confidence.
exercises.answer: Students can not only improve their vocabulary but also develop confidence.
exercises.explanation: 动词并列：improve... develop...。

exercises.prompt: There were less visitors in 2016 than in 2017.
exercises.answer: There were fewer visitors in 2016 than in 2017.
exercises.explanation: visitors 可数复数，使用 fewer。

exercises.prompt: 政府不仅需要改善公共交通，还需要确保无障碍出行。
exercises.answer: Governments need not only to improve public transport but also to ensure accessible travel.
exercises.explanation: 不定式平行。

exercises.prompt: 一些人更喜欢在线阅读，而不是购买纸质书。
exercises.answer: Some people prefer reading online to buying printed books.
exercises.explanation: prefer doing A to doing B。

exercises.prompt: 使用 not only...but also... 和 rather than 写两句关于城市公共空间的论证。
exercises.answer: Pedestrian-friendly areas can not only encourage exercise but also improve social interaction. Residents may choose to walk rather than drive for short journeys.
exercises.explanation: 保持并列成分形式一致。

lessons.title: 定语从句、分词结构与悬垂修饰
lessons.note: which/that 从句必须依附完整主句；分词短语的逻辑主语通常应与主句主语一致。with + 名词 + V-ing 常用于补充说明。
lessons.wrong: Foods containing sufficient protein, which can support growth. / Living in a rapidly developing age, the productivity is greater.
lessons.right: Foods rich in protein can support growth. / Modern production systems have increased food output.
patterns: Having + 过去分词, + 同一逻辑主语

exercises.prompt: Students ___ lack self-discipline may benefit from closer supervision.
exercises.answer: who

exercises.prompt: The time saved can be redirected towards tasks ___ require human judgement.
exercises.answer: that

exercises.prompt: ___ visited the sites before, residents may see little reason to return.
exercises.answer: Having

exercises.prompt: AI can support doctors by analysing clinical data, ___ improves efficiency.
exercises.answer: which

exercises.prompt: Foods rich in vitamins, which support normal bodily functions.
exercises.answer: Foods rich in vitamins support normal bodily functions.
exercises.explanation: 原句只有名词短语+定语从句，没有完整主句。

exercises.prompt: Living in a rapidly developing age, food production has become more efficient.
exercises.answer: As technology develops, food production has become more efficient.
exercises.explanation: food production 不能是 living 的主语。

exercises.prompt: 那些缺乏自律的学生可能需要更多指导。
exercises.answer: Students who lack self-discipline may need more guidance.
exercises.explanation: who 引导限定性定语从句。

exercises.prompt: 以前参观过这些景点的居民可能觉得没有必要再去。
exercises.answer: Having visited these attractions before, residents may see little reason to return.
exercises.explanation: 现在分词完成式的逻辑主语是 residents。

exercises.prompt: 写两句：一处用 who/which 定语从句，一处用分词结构，讨论AI。
exercises.answer: Students who rely excessively on AI may struggle to think independently. By providing immediate feedback, AI can also support individual learning.
exercises.explanation: 检查每一处主句是否完整。

lessons.title: 让步、转折与结果衔接
lessons.note: although + 完整句；despite + 名词/V-ing；however 通常连接两个独立句，应有句号或分号；连接词必须反映真实逻辑。
lessons.wrong: Despite small-class education can offer some benefits... / Nowadays..., however I do not... / While, historically...
lessons.right: Although small classes offer benefits, ... / ... . However, I do not ... / Historically, ... . Nevertheless, ...
patterns: As a result + 结果；In addition + 补充

exercises.prompt: ___ small classes offer benefits, they are not essential.
exercises.answer: Although

exercises.prompt: ___ the benefits of digital media, printed books may remain popular.
exercises.answer: Despite

exercises.prompt: AI can automate routine tasks. ___, it may displace some workers.
exercises.answer: However

exercises.prompt: Consumers often buy too much food. ___, edible food may go to waste.
exercises.answer: As a result

exercises.prompt: Despite AI can improve efficiency, there are risks.
exercises.answer: Although AI can improve efficiency, there are risks.
exercises.explanation: despite 不能直接接完整句。

exercises.prompt: Online reading is convenient, however it cannot fully replace print.
exercises.answer: Online reading is convenient. However, it cannot fully replace print.
exercises.explanation: however 不能只靠逗号连接两个主句。

exercises.prompt: 尽管自主创业带来较大风险，它也可能提供更高的自主性。
exercises.answer: Although self-employment involves greater risks, it may offer more autonomy.
exercises.explanation: 让步主从句。

exercises.prompt: 政府投入有限，因此公共服务应该得到优先保障。
exercises.answer: Public funding is limited. Therefore, essential public services should receive priority.
exercises.explanation: therefore 引出真正的结果。

exercises.prompt: 用 Although 和 Nevertheless 写两句论证国际旅游的利弊。
exercises.answer: Although international tourism can place pressure on local communities, it also creates opportunities for cultural exchange. Nevertheless, appropriate management is necessary to reduce the risks.
exercises.explanation: 两句连接关系要清楚。

lessons.title: 词性、近义词与形容词搭配
lessons.wrong: potential measurements / a cost-effectiveness way / food produce / most efficient way to maintain health / sleeping quality
lessons.right: possible measures / a cost-effective approach / food production / most effective way to maintain health / sleep quality

exercises.prompt: Governments should introduce practical ___ to reduce waste.
exercises.answer: measures

exercises.prompt: AI-powered tools offer a cost-___ way to practise speaking.
exercises.answer: effective

exercises.prompt: Modern food ___ can increase the supply of fresh products.
exercises.answer: production

exercises.prompt: Regular exercise is an ___ way to relieve stress.
exercises.answer: effective

exercises.prompt: These measurements could raise public awareness.
exercises.answer: These measures could raise public awareness.
exercises.explanation: 措施是 measures，测量是 measurements。

exercises.prompt: Exercise can improve sleeping quality.
exercises.answer: Exercise can improve sleep quality.
exercises.explanation: 固定名词搭配：sleep quality。

exercises.prompt: 高效的回收体系可以降低运营成本。
exercises.answer: Efficient recycling systems can reduce operating costs.
exercises.explanation: efficient 强调资源利用效率。

exercises.prompt: 需要采取有效措施保护文化遗产。
exercises.answer: Effective measures are needed to protect cultural heritage.
exercises.explanation: effective 强调实际效果。

exercises.prompt: 写两句比较effective和efficient在环保议题中的区别。
exercises.answer: An effective recycling policy increases participation. An efficient recycling system processes materials with less time and fewer resources.
exercises.explanation: 明确“效果”和“资源效率”的区别。

lessons.title: Task 1：时态、数据比较与指代
lessons.note: 小作文只陈述图表事实；overview 概括主要特征，不列所有数字。比较对象要一致，百分比变化与百分点变化不同，避免误用 amount/number。
lessons.wrong: the proportion growed / as age growing older / that for men were leading / the number of water use
lessons.right: the proportion grew / as age increased / the figure for men remained higher / the amount of water used
patterns: the figure for A was higher than that for B
the proportion of ... / the number of ... / the amount of ...

exercises.prompt: The employment rate for men ___ from 70% to approximately 92%.
exercises.answer: rose

exercises.prompt: The proportion increased ___ 10 percentage points.
exercises.answer: by

exercises.prompt: The figure for men was consistently higher than ___ for women.
exercises.answer: that

exercises.prompt: The ___ of visitors rose to 3.5 million.
exercises.answer: number

exercises.prompt: The percentage growed gradually between 1976 and 2011.
exercises.answer: The percentage grew gradually between 1976 and 2011.
exercises.explanation: grow 的过去式是 grew。

exercises.prompt: The number of household water increased sharply.
exercises.answer: The amount of household water used increased sharply.
exercises.explanation: water 不可数，用 amount。

exercises.prompt: 到2017年，游客总数已增至350万。
exercises.answer: By 2017, the total number of visitors had risen to 3.5 million.
exercises.explanation: 过去完成时可用于强调到过去某一时间点的变化。

exercises.prompt: 2011年男性就业率始终高于女性。
exercises.answer: In 2011, the employment rate for men remained higher than that for women.
exercises.explanation: that 指代 employment rate。

exercises.prompt: 写2句Overview，概括折线图中总人数上升且两类人群趋势不同；不要编造数字。
exercises.answer: Overall, the total number of visitors increased considerably over the period. However, the two visitor groups followed different trends.
exercises.explanation: Task 1 不解释原因、不增加未经图表支持的细节。

lessons.title: 论证句准确性：限制、指代与过度绝对化
lessons.note: 不宜把“可能”“在某些条件下”写成“一定”“所有”。避免 paper news must be reliable / AI replaces all teachers / fewer calories guarantee health 等不受证据支持的结论。
lessons.wrong: printed information is always more reliable / only one way can’t guarantee people’s health / AI can do more excel jobs
lessons.right: reputable print publications often provide edited reports / neither approach alone is sufficient for all aspects of health / AI can perform some hazardous tasks
patterns: if part of the revenue is reinvested

exercises.prompt: AI ___ help teachers provide individual feedback, but it cannot replace all their roles.
exercises.answer: can

exercises.prompt: Negative effects are not ___.
exercises.answer: inevitable

exercises.prompt: Tourism can support cultural protection ___ revenue is reinvested locally.
exercises.answer: if

exercises.prompt: Printed publications are not ___ more reliable than digital journalism.
exercises.answer: necessarily

exercises.prompt: All online information is unreliable, so printed newspapers are better.
exercises.answer: Some unverified online information can be misleading, while reputable publications may provide carefully edited reports.
exercises.explanation: 避免 all / always 的未经支持判断。

exercises.prompt: Healthy food completely prevents all chronic diseases.
exercises.answer: A balanced diet can help reduce the risk of some chronic diseases.
exercises.explanation: 用 reduce the risk of 更审慎。

exercises.prompt: 如果合理管理，旅游的积极影响可能超过负面影响。
exercises.answer: When managed responsibly, the benefits of tourism can outweigh its disadvantages.
exercises.explanation: 限制条件使论证更严谨。

exercises.prompt: 小班教学有帮助，但不是语言学习成功的必要条件。
exercises.answer: Small classes can be beneficial, but they are not a prerequisite for successful language learning.
exercises.explanation: not essential 与 makes no difference 不等同。

exercises.prompt: 写两句讨论AI影响工作，必须含 may 和 however，避免绝对判断。
exercises.answer: AI may displace some workers in routine occupations. However, retraining programmes can help affected employees move into new roles.
exercises.explanation: 用限定表达支持可靠推论。
